testsuite.name: koh.portfolio.springapi.presentation.vaccination.VaccinationControllerTest

testcase.name: DELETE /api/v1/vaccinations/{id} - 他ユーザーのペットは403とVACCINATION-002を返す
PATCH /api/v1/vaccinations/{id}/reschedule - 接種予定日が無い場合Validation失敗
POST /api/v1/pets/{petId}/vaccinations - ワクチン名・接種予定日が無い場合Validation失敗
PATCH /api/v1/vaccinations/{id}/complete - 未来の接種完了日はValidation失敗
PATCH /api/v1/vaccinations/{id}/cancel - 不正な状態遷移は409とVACCINATION-003を返す
POST /api/v1/pets/{petId}/vaccinations - 接種予定登録成功
PATCH /api/v1/vaccinations/{id}/complete - body省略時は完了日nullでUseCaseを呼ぶ
GET /api/v1/pets/{petId}/vaccinations - 接種予定一覧取得成功
PATCH /api/v1/vaccinations/{id}/complete - 不正な状態遷移は409とVACCINATION-003を返す
